metadata.name: ito-inference
metadata.description: Inspect the availability of model serving on a completed Itô compute booking and, when the canonical backend becomes available, hand off an explicitly confirmed serving manifest. Use after ito-compute has booked GPU nodes and the user asks for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ito-serve, hosted Kimi, or self-hosted open-weights inference. ECC implements no serving stack of its own.
